lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT

lines.speaker: header
lines.text: Complaint No. 05-0157-955 Page 565 File Number

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: He came over and asked you what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: If I could help him move somethin'.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, let's, to this point now, I think we're pretty close to the truth. How close are we Brendan?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Pretty close.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, then give us the little parts that we don't have yet up ta that point. Does Steven? There's somethin' in there we're missin'. You heard her, I have a feelin' he saw you, you saw him somethin' in here that we're missin' cuz you know we're not idiots, I don't see him comin' over to the house and asking you to help him unless you knows you know somethin' so tell us what you knew that he knew.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: It's OK Brendan. We already know.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: I think you went over to his house and then he asked him to get his mail somethin' in here is missing.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well, when I got the mail there was like a envelope in there with his name on it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, now we're goin' so what did you do?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I knocked on the door and he answered it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Yeah, and then what?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I gave it to him and then I left.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Come on now. You just heard screaming over there.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You're making this hard on us and yourself.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Be honest. You went inside, didn't you? (Brendan nods “yes”)
